  2. How did we get our start?

    Casmilee began when a group of friends shared a passion for organizing and simplifying life. They created practical and functional storage cases that were made to last.

    Why do we love what we do?

    Because we believe in the power of organization to im-prove people's lives, and we take pride in the quality of our products and exceptional customer ser-vice.

    What problem are we solving?

    Today, we continue to expand our product line and strive to provide affordable storage that solve the problem of disorganization.

    Product Description

    Ultimate Storage Case for Portable Chargers – Your Essential Travel Companion!

    The storage case is designed for iWALK portable charger power bank and is compatible with various fast-charging mini battery packs from brands like for JEJILL, for Charmast, for LanLuk, for VEGER, for Swyop, for Feob, for Taegila, and for Kuulaa and so on.

    Designed for All Your Daily Adventures

    Lightweight and compact, this case is ideal for a variety of usage scenarios:

    · On Your Travels: Keep it in your luggage or carry-on for easy access during long flights or road trips. Never worry about low battery while exploring new destinations!

    · During Hiking and Camping: Clip it to your backpack with the comfortable mountaineering buckle, ensuring you have power when you need it most in the great outdoors.

    · When Your Phone Battery is Low: Ideal for quick recharges while on the go—whether you’re navigating a new city or capturing memories with friends.

    · At Work: Slip it into your bag to ensure your devices stay charged throughout busy workdays, keeping you connected during important meetings or while working on the move.

    · Everyday Carry: Its compact design makes it ideal for daily use—carry it with you to stay powered up no matter where life takes you.

    Please note: The power bank shown in the images is for demonstration purposes only and is not included.
